dct_description_sm: Abstract: This datalayer was developed by the City's GIS consulting firm, Camp Dresser and McKee, Inc. (CDM) and is a polyline coverage of property lines and associated property information for the City of Somerville, Massachusetts.

Purpose: These data are intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and may be used for basic applications such as viewing, querying, and map output production. This layer will provide a basemap for layers related to real property or to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data. More advanced user applications may focus on urban planning, public works, or utilities purposes (including defining boundaries, managing assets and facilities, integrating attribute databases with geographic features, spatial analysis, and presentation output).

Supplemental information: Created by automating the assessor maps. Lines were placed using coordinate information found on the assessor plans. The parcel lines were not board digitized. Please note that some parcel lines were moved to avoid conflicts with buildings in the BECo data.
